mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_inspect_run_item (run_id, stage, result, event_id, fp_id, title, severity, detail, input_tokens, output_tokens, message_id, card_json) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stage}, #{result}, #{eventId}, #{fpId}, #{title}, #{severity}, #{detail}, COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0), #{messageId}, #{cardJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, stage, result, event_id, fp_id, title, severity, detail, input_tokens, output_tokens, message_id, IF(card_json IS NULL, NULL, '1') AS card_json, create_time FROM ai_inspect_run_item WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id
SELECT card_json FROM ai_inspect_run_item WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND stage = 'PUSH' AND result = 'SKIP' AND event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_inspect_run_item WHERE create_time < #{before} LIMIT 20000
